tasks.goal: Inquire about automatic game mode low-latency switching when console turns on
tasks.hint: Ask if TV detects gaming console input automatically.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about auto low latency mode switching.

Japanese.goal: ゲーム機の電源を入れると自動で低遅延のゲームモードに切り替わるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: テレビがゲーム機の入力を自動で認識するか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if screen features anti-burn-in pixel shift pixel refresher routine
tasks.hint: Inquire about automated OLED screen care routines.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about pixel shift screen care features.

Japanese.goal: 焼き付き防止のピクセルシフトやパネルリフレッシュ機能があるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 有機EL画面を自動で保護する機能について聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about haul-away recycling fees for packaging cardboard and foam
tasks.hint: Ask if delivery team takes away large cardboard box.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about delivery packaging removal fees.

Japanese.goal: 梱包の段ボールや発泡スチロールの引き取り・リサイクル料金について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 配達の人が大きな段ボール箱を持ち帰ってくれるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm scheduled delivery time slot window and driver phone notification
tasks.hint: Verify delivery day arrival notification protocol.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed delivery time window and call protocol.

Japanese.goal: 配達の時間帯と配達員からの電話連絡を確認する
Japanese.hint: 配達当日の到着連絡の方法を確認しましょう。

tasks.goal: Negotiate free express next-day delivery given store delay in processing order
tasks.hint: Request waived delivery fee due to processing delay.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated free express delivery due to order delay.

Japanese.goal: 店側の注文処理が遅れたので、翌日の速達配送を無料にしてもらうよう交渉する
Japanese.hint: 処理の遅れを理由に配送料を無料にしてもらうよう頼みましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if receipt includes full serial number for warranty registration purposes
tasks.hint: Verify serial number is printed on purchase documentation.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified serial number inclusion on receipt.
tasks.scene_hint: Receipt printer hums as long paper transaction bill prints out.

Japanese.goal: 保証登録のためにレシートに製造番号が全部載っているか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 購入書類に製造番号が印刷されているか確認しましょう。

tasks.goal: Request formal tax invoice detailing VAT or state sales tax breakdown
tasks.hint: Ask cashier for itemized tax documentation.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested formal tax invoice receipt.

Japanese.goal: 付加価値税や州の売上税の内訳が記載された正式な税務用の請求書を頼む
Japanese.hint: レジで税額の明細がわかる書類をお願いしましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm store contact phone number for post-delivery setup support
tasks.hint: Ask advisor who to call if setup issues arise at home.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed customer support phone number.

Japanese.goal: 配達後の設置サポートのための店の電話番号を確認する
Japanese.hint: 自宅で設置に問題が起きたらどこに電話すればいいか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about store replacement policy if TV screen gets damaged during self-transport
tasks.hint: Ask advisor about transport insurance or store liability.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about self-transport damage policy.

Japanese.goal: 自分で運ぶ途中で画面が壊れた場合の店の交換規定について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 運送保険や店の責任範囲について聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Negotiate inclusion of high-speed HDMI 2.1 cable with TV purchase
tasks.hint: Ask advisor to throw in complimentary HDMI cable.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated complimentary HDMI 2.1 cable.

Japanese.goal: テレビの購入に高速HDMI 2.1ケーブルを付けてもらうよう交渉する
Japanese.hint: HDMIケーブルを無料でおまけしてもらえないか頼みましょう。

name_translations.Japanese: 家電量販店でテレビを買う
